authority: User H-R3-P01 review acceptance and P02 exploratory preparation; at most two new exploratory seeds; no confirmatory execution
preserve: All P01 source/prereg/raw/review/results; all production simulation/sensor/actor/controller files, Frozen Policy F and actor898; RGB-D+LiDAR; sensor lineage off exactly as P01; main WIP/stash

arms.B1: Frozen P01 prediction pursuit, no yaw
arms.B3: Frozen P01 pursuit plus informed lateral viewpoint
arms.B4: Sham SIDE: B3 same-state lateral magnitude, fixed SHA256(seed,env) random sign independent of chosen side
arms.B5: Nominal effort-matched B2: pursuit direction with same-state B3 pre-filter speed norm

controller.source: motar_eval/h_r3_arms.py preserved; same inputs/geometry/parameters; new pure opt-in evaluation module
controller.shared: same point safety, norm cap, riskcap governor, altitude hold; never undo safety attenuation
controller.information: own state, permitted tracker belief, raw LiDAR and delivered camera; no GT/silhouette/provenance/semantic online
controller.limits: B4 retains LoS-derived magnitude/activation and tests side only. B5 matches nominal command budget, not realized effort; all subsequent effort/filter/trajectory differences measured, never excluded.

intervention.trigger: same online first-episode detection-loss rule as P01
intervention.duration: FIXED20 control steps unless crash/capture/reset; camera reobservation does not resume PolicyF early; differs explicitly from P01 variable-duration control
intervention.matching: all six arms must have identical t0 and bitwise per-env full state/actor/raw RGB-depth-LiDAR/tracker sensor history for every step before t0; any mismatch is an integrity failure, not a selectively dropped cohort

rng.initialization: identical constructor seed/config/asset identities across arms; hooks installed after player build and before env_reset
rng.keys: SHA256(run_seed, logical_step, env_id, episode_id, stream_name, per-env invocation); never Python hash
rng.reset: serialize each env manager/task reset with separate saved/restored Python/NumPy/TorchCPU+taskCUDA seeded scopes; episode increments once before manager reset, shared token consumed by task
rng.waypoint: separate per-env/callsite/step/episode streams for adaptive waypoint subsets
rng.action: fork and restore discarded stochastic actor samples despite deterministic action selection
rng.step: common exogenous full-batch step stream independent of reset/waypoint consumption; action-dependent sensor observations remain rendered normally
rng.scope: fixed N only; not batch-size invariant; active exact receipt only. Fail closed for unhandled perturbations/private sensor noise/disturbance/route/CV/physical target options
rng.proof: CPU order/split/unrelated-reset tests plus GPU forced-other-env reset comparison; record keyed per-env probe draws and raw-sensor/state digests

identity.actual_detection: clone returned _detect_rgbd tuple mask[5], delivered flag[3], reported measurement[0]; never use renderer bbox as a detection
identity.gt: visible target silhouette used only for evaluator scoring
identity.primary: within20 post-action observations before terminal: delivered camera AND intersection>=1 AND intersection/detector_pixels>=0.5 AND continuous reported centroid within Chebyshev1pixel of a visible target-pixel center (epsilon1e-5)
identity.centroid: c=measurement_vehicle-camera_offset; u=cx-fx*c_y/c_x; v=cy-fy*c_z/c_x; invalid forward/nonfinite cannot pass
identity.label: identity-correct under preregistered spatial-support rule, not persistent real-world object identity
identity.record: detected/visible/intersection/false-support pixel counts, dominance, target recall, IoU, actual-mask bbox, reported centroid, centroid-near-support and spatial score
identity.guards: equal detect/camera resolution, zero detection latency, no empirical error/measurement perturbation; no stale frame
side_by_side: P01 literal flag+any-target-pixel metric including historical same-index rule
identity.sensitivity: dominance thresholds0.25/0.75 reported diagnostic only; primary remains0.5

population.denominator: all matched geometric events, including misses/terminals; report each class including zero counts; first-episode only; reobservation at same-index crash/capture/reset is failure; never use new-episode detections

telemetry: fixed-window and control-only displacement and squared-speed integrals
safety attenuation/stall, nearest raw LiDAR clearance, contacts/crash/capture/timeout
target trajectory and RNG equality before terminal

effort_interpretation.mechanical_energy: NOT_RECORDED; squared-speed integral is a kinematic proxy
effort_interpretation.equivalence_diagnostic: mean paired relative difference within10% separately for control translation, commanded squared-speed integral and realized squared-speed integral (no zero-denominator imputation)
effort_interpretation.failure: imbalance does not remove events or alter sensor-effect estimates; disallows claim that realized movement/speed effects were ruled out

analysis.others: B2/B3/B4/B5 and B0/B1 context all reported
analysis.unit: seed cluster with one event per scene/env; two seeds insufficient population inference
analysis.report: per-seed counts/effects/discordance, equal-seed mean and observed range; event-level paired resampling conditional on these seeds explicitly descriptive; no confirmatory p claim
analysis.dependence: report shared-seed variation and RNG/target noninterference; do not estimate reliable ICC from two clusters; two-seed two-sided sign-flip minimum p0.5
analysis.planning: future minimum effects10/15/20pp x discordance0.2/0.4/0.6 x within-seed ICC0/.01/.05/.1 x event-yield scenarios; three contrasts Holm; recommend seed/event targets from sensitivity, not P01 p-values or two-cluster ICC

smoke.gate: same-state nominal norm parity; zero prebranch mismatches; unaffected15env bitwise rawsensor/state/RNG equality under forced reset; evaluator off/on equality; finite complete telemetry, at least one scripted trigger and nonzero lateral sample else INCONCLUSIVE; any scripted arm own-trigger collision fraction>.30 STOP before P02
